# Who are the Bundesliga's top scorers from each country?

07.06.2026

From Harry Kane to Gerd Müller, we take a look at the league's leading marksmen from each country.

*Data correct as of 7 June 2026

Germany: Gerd Müller - 365 Bundesliga goals

In 60 years of the Bundesliga's existence, none have been able to threaten Der Bomber's all-time high tally of 365 strikes, each of which he scored in the mighty red and white colours of Bayern Munich. Across the span of his 14 seasons in the Bundesliga between 1965 to 1979, the late, great Müller managed more than 30 goals four times, and famously held the all-time record of Bundesliga goals in a season with 40 to his name. Croatia: Andrej Kramarić - 140

Kramarić is the top scoring active player in the Bundesliga having amassed 140 goals during his 10 and a half years at TSG Hoffenheim. It's a record the Croatian will be hoping to extent next season, having signed a new deal with the club that will keep him in Sinsheim until 2028.

Brazil: Giovane Élber - 133 

From one South American goal-getter to another, Élber was highly successful in Bayern colours in the early 2000s helping the club to four league titles and one Champions League title. During his six seasons with the club, he was league top scorer five times. Élber, who also enjoyed a prolific spell for VfB Stuttgart prior to his move to Munich, was also the Bundesliga's top non-German goalscorer before being overtaken by former teammate Pizarro.

Bosnia and Herzegovina: Vedad Ibišević - 127 

Switzerland: Stephane Chapuisat - 106  

Netherlands: Arjen Robben - 99 

One of the finest Dutch players the Bundesliga has ever seen, Robben dazzled the German top flight with his skills and unstoppable ability to cut inside and get shots away with his left foot. Falling just short of the 100 goals mark, Robben enjoyed a stellar career with Bayern, most famously scoring the winning goal in the 2013 Champions League final against Dortmund. 

England: Harry Kane - 98 

Kane has been the Bundesliga's standout talent since swapping England for Germany in August 2023, winning the Torjägerkanone in each and every season since completing his move to Bayern.

Alongside Michael Olise and Luis Díaz, Kane has spearfronted the world's most lethal trio as Bayern have smashed record after record this last campaign. The trio were vital in helping Bayern break the longstanding record for most Bundesliga goals in a season as the champions finished with a whopping 122 league goals to their name.

Gabon: Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang - 98 

South Korea: Bum-Kun Cha - 98 

Ghana: Anthony Yeboah - 96 

Austria: Anton "Toni" Polster - 90

#### Kompany: "Wir haben Bock auf das Spiel"

#### Das sagt Kompany

"Hoffenheim ist eine laufstarke Mannschaft. Sie sind eine gute Mischung mit unterschiedlichen Profilen. Aber wir haben immer gezeigt, wenn eine Mannschaft diese Intensität bringen will, dann sind wir auch gerne dabei. Ich finde es immer gut, wenn die gegnerische Mannschaft diese Intensität bringt. #### Keine Ausfälle bei Bayern

Stand Samstagvormittag gibt es bei den Münchenern keine definitiven Ausfälle zu verzeichnen. Neuer soll am Samstag wieder trainieren und auch Kane kann nach kurzer Pause unter der Woche wieder mitwirken.

#### Das sagt Ilzer

"Spiele gegen Bayern München sind immer etwas Besonderes. Sie sind das Nonplusultra im deutschen Fußball und selbst im europäischen Fußball gehören sie zu den größten Namen. Wir sind sehr entspannt, aber auch fokussiert."

#### Gnabry bleibt bis 2028

Der FC Bayern und Serge Gnabry haben den im Sommer auslaufenden Vertrag des deutschen Nationalspielers bis zum 30. Juni 2028 verlängert. Sportvorstand Max Eberl sagt über die Verlängerung: "Serge Gnabry ist mit dem FC Bayern gewachsen und zählt zu den absoluten Stützen dieser Mannschaft – auf dem Platz und in der Kabine ist er ungemein wichtig." Gnabry selbst freut sich auf die weiteren Jahre beim Rekordmeister und liefert für seine Verlängerung gleich mehrere Gründe: "Die Mannschaft, das Trainerteam, der ganze Verein, die Fans, die Stadt, das Umfeld: Ich fühle mich beim FC Bayern sehr wohl."

#### Unglaubliche Rettungsaktionen!

#### Perfekter Jahresstart

Hoffenheim hat als einziger Bundesligist im neuen Jahr keine Punkte abgegeben, alle fünf Spiele haben die Kraichgauer gewonnen – eingestellter Vereinsrekord!

#### Gegen Schwächere

Der FC Bayern blieb am letzten Spieltag beim Hamburger SV (2:2) zum vierten Mal in dieser Bundesliga-Saison sieglos (drei Unentschieden, eine Niederlage) und immer stand der Gegner vor dem Spiel in der unteren Tabellenhälfte (zuvor Union, Mainz und Augsburg).

#### Historischer Einbruch

Einen vergleichbaren Vorsprung hat Bayern in einer Rückrunde bisher einmal verspielt: 1992/93 lagen die Münchner nach dem 22. Spieltag umgerechnet sechs Punkte vor Werder Bremen, das am Ende die Schale holte.

#### Vorsprung geschmolzen

Der Vorsprung auf Dortmund ist von elf auf sechs Zähler geschrumpft, Hoffenheim könnte mit einem Sieg ebenfalls auf sechs Punkte herankommen.

#### Ungewohnt

Der FC Bayern blieb zuletzt erstmals in dieser Saison zwei Bundesliga-Spiele nacheinander sieglos, holte gegen Augsburg (1:2) und den HSV (2:2) trotz Führungen nur einen von sechs Punkten. Drei sieglose Bundesliga-Partien in Serie gab es unter Vincent Kompany noch nie.

19.07.2026

#### That's a wrap

The 23rd World Cup is over as Spain win the title for a second time and we potentially saw the last of Lionel Messi on the world stage. Harry Kane captained England to third place and France's Michael Olise broke Pelé's record for assists. But now attentions turn back to domestic football and the impending start of the 2026/27 season. Bundesliga clubs are already back in training as they gear up to go again over the next year. Make sure to follow pre-season and the season itself right here!

#### Bundesliga breakdown

A total of 16 Bundesliga-based players got a goal at this tournament, netting a total of 26 times. Harry Kane led the way with six, while Deniz Undav and Johan Manzambi bagged three each. Malik Tillman converted two free-kicks, with a single strike from each of Connor Metcalfe, Romano Schmid, Luis Díaz, Nathaniel Brown, Jamal Musiala, Felix Nmecha, Nico Schlotterbeck, Mattias Svanberg, Gio Reyna, Marcel Sabitzer, Kaishu Sano and Antonio Nusa.

#### Kylian Mbappe wins the Golden Boot

Mbappe has won the Golden Boot with 10 goals, narrowly beating out Messi with eight. That also means that the Frenchman becomes the first player to win two World Cup Golden Boots.

#### Spain lift the trophy

Spain finally have their moment and lift the Jules Rimet trophy for the second time in their history - the first since their World Cup triumph in 2010.
Argentina battled hard, but they ultimately couldn't break down their opposition.

#### First ever World Cup Final half-time show

In addition to the musical performances of the closing ceremony, fans were treated to a half-time show featuring megastars Shakira, BTS, Madonna, Justin Bieber, Coldplay, and more.

#### Landmark performance

Laura Pausini, Nicole Scherzinger and Robbie Williams also delivered a stellar performance, before actor Tom Cruise took to the field to make a rousing speech ahead of the national anthems.

#### Closing ceremony in full swing

As the world prepares for the final game of the FIFA World Cup 2026, a star-studded musical line-up which includes the likes of Post Malone, Swae Lee and IShowSpeed set the tone for the final at the MetLife Stadium in New York/New Jersey with a spectacular closing ceremony over an hour before kick-off.

#### RB Leipzig's Martín Demichelis talks up Argentina's chances

#### 19 July: Final awaits Spain and Argentina

The stage is set in New York, where reigning world champions Argentina will take on European champions Spain in the FIFA World Cup Final. Bayer Leverkusen midfielder Exequiel Palacios could become the first Bundesliga player to win the World Cup twice if Argentina retain the trophy. Scaloni's side will face a tough challenge against a Spanish outfit that has conceded only one goal on their way to the final.

#### Kane 'gutted'

"Gutted for the boys, gutted for everyone - the team, the staff, the fans," the Bayern and England striker said after the semi-final defeat to Argentina. "We played a good game the large majority of it. When we went 1-0 up we seemed to try and hold on, which at this level is not enough. #### Quarter-final bracket confirmed

With the conclusion of the last 16 action, the quarter-final matches are now set in stone. France meet Morocco, whom they beat 2-0 in the 2022 World Cup semi-final while Spain face Belgium for the 24th time. Norway will play England for the first time since September 2014, while Switzerland will look to avenge their 2014 World Cup last 16 defeat against Argentina.

#### Bundesliga’s star performers

A total of 11 Bundesliga players have earned 14 Player of the Match accolades at this World Cup. Harry Kane (vs. Croatia & DR Congo), Luis Díaz (vs. Uzbekistan & Ghana) and Johan Manzambi (vs. Bosnia & Canada) have all won it twice. Yan Diomande (vs. Ecuador), Michael Olise (vs. Senegal), Ismael Saibari (vs. Scotland), Deniz Undav (vs. Côte d'Ivoire), Ibrahim Maza (vs. Jordan), Antonio Nusa (vs. Côte d'Ivoire), Malik Tillman (vs. Bosnia) and Gregor Kobel (vs. Colombia) have also earned the trophy.

Reigning world champions Argentina survived a scare against Cabo Verde in the round of 32 in Miami. They were pegged back twice, once in normal time, which finished 1-1, and then again at 2-2 in extra time before a Lionel Messi corner was deflected into his own net by Diney Borges.
